from solution import get_perrin


def test_issue_base_n0():
    """Perrin base case P(0) is 3."""
    # P(0)=3 by definition
    assert get_perrin(0) == 3


def test_issue_base_n1():
    """Perrin base case P(1) is 0."""
    # P(1)=0 by definition
    assert get_perrin(1) == 0


def test_issue_base_n2():
    """Perrin base case P(2) is 2."""
    # P(2)=2 by definition
    assert get_perrin(2) == 2


def test_issue_first_recursive_n3():
    """Recurrence gives P(3) from P(1)+P(0)."""
    # P(3)=P(1)+P(0)=0+3=3
    assert get_perrin(3) == 3


def test_issue_boundary_n4():
    """Recurrence gives P(4) from P(2)+P(1)."""
    # P(4)=P(2)+P(1)=2+0=2
    assert get_perrin(4) == 2


def test_issue_mid_n5():
    """Recurrence gives P(5) from P(3)+P(2)."""
    # P(5)=P(3)+P(2)=3+2=5
    assert get_perrin(5) == 5


def test_issue_mid_n7():
    """Recurrence gives P(7) from P(5)+P(4)."""
    # P(7)=P(5)+P(4)=5+2=7
    assert get_perrin(7) == 7


def test_issue_example_n9():
    """Example asserts get_perrin(9) == 12."""
    # P(6)=5, P(7)=7, P(8)=10, P(9)=P(7)+P(6)=7+5=12
    assert get_perrin(9) == 12


def test_issue_next_n10():
    """Recurrence gives P(10) from P(8)+P(7)."""
    # P(10)=P(8)+P(7)=10+7=17
    assert get_perrin(10) == 17


def test_issue_larger_n15():
    """Recurrence gives P(15) from P(13)+P(12)."""
    # P(11)=22, P(12)=29, P(13)=39, P(15)=P(13)+P(12)=39+29=68
    assert get_perrin(15) == 68


def test_contract_callable():
    """Public interface defines get_perrin(n) as a callable function."""
    assert callable(get_perrin)


def test_contract_returns_int():
    """Perrin numbers are integers so get_perrin returns int."""
    # P(9)=P(7)+P(6)=7+5=12 as int
    assert isinstance(get_perrin(9), int)
